_comment: Owner's rules (2026-10-15): extra kill XP on top of each monster's official XP. Kill XP = base XP x levelsAbove x stars. levelsAbove: how many levels the monster is above you (more than the highest listed use the highest). stars: the monster's star rating (its power in the game data; 0 counts as 1). A monster below your level still loses 25% per level, as in the Grimoire, before these apply. Restart the server after editing.
